notes.title: Ver. 80000 Update Release Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for playing ONE PIECE Bounty Rush.
The game was updated to Ver. 80000.
Please download the update from the store you downloaded this game from.

[b][h2]■ Update Details[/h2][/b]
[h3]▼ Scout Animation[/h3]
Adjusted certain Scout animation elements.
- Added an animation featuring Gear Five Monkey D. Luffy, who will appear under certain conditions.
- Added an animation showing the Grade of characters obtained.
- Adjusted some other animation display conditions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160666/92cd4166a19d86eb3e6179b68f1f9ab9b61ee54a.png[/img]

[h3]▼Party Number[/h3]
The upper limit on the number of parties has been unlocked.
- Bounty Coins can be used to unlock additional parties, up to a maximum of 10.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160666/bfb04672b83705c4a207724b597c8188189a7961.png[/img]

[h3]▼Casual Match[/h3]
""Free Match"" has been changed to ""Casual Match"".
- Without using a Passcode, you can join either ""Normal"" or ""Fixed Level"" battles.
- You can enjoy playing your favorite characters or characters you want to practice.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160666/f299cc471bcec6287537c3ff3e1097f5ec92977a.png[/img]

[h3]▼Class[/h3]
Classes have been added in the SS League.
- Classes have been newly added based on your current League Score in SS League.
- Your class varies depending on your League Score and League Ranking in the current season.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160666/3b4c4734bfe547b0e21313aecdf67dfa02c65f32.png[/img]

- You can acquire a class frame at the end of the season depending on your class at that time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160666/1b39a093ce96849f32764a0f6b7d23e7d5617b10.png[/img]

*You can set your class frame obtained only for one season from the Profile customization screen.
*Classes do not affect matchmaking.

[h3]▼Matchmaking[/h3]
League battle matchmaking has been adjusted so that SS League players can only be matched with other SS League players.
*More details here.
The following changes will be implemented for the current League at the end of the Season.
① Your Current League will change based on your highest League previously reached after Season 144 ends.
② League Downgrade Limitations after Season 144 ends.

[h3]▼Profile Background[/h3]
""Mission [Character]"" has been added to ""Profile Customization"" backgrounds.
- By completing the acquisition conditions for specific characters, you can obtain their personal background.
- Added a profile background for ""4★ Blackbeard Pirates Kuzan"".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160666/ec5081b0bfc5aba62cfeec52d874c91cec6412da.png[/img]

*Other Extreme Legendary Characters are scheduled to sequentially receive profile backgrounds when they are released or during their return.

[h3]▼Medal Rush 7[/h3]
The lineup in ""Medal Rush 7 Medal Point Exchange"" has been updated. Following this addition, more Event Medal materials have been added to the lineup until 2/2/2025 18:59 (UTC).
- Added previously available Event Medals such as Ulti Medal materials.
*Regardless of when Medal Rush 7 is purchased, every Sunday at 19:00 (UTC), the Medal Point Exchange lineup will be updated and the Event Medals you can craft and upgrade will change.

[h3]▼Adjustments[/h3]
Adjusted the behavior of the following characters when they execute Perfect Dodges in response to certain characters' attacks.
- Roger Pirates / First Mate Silvers Rayleigh
- FILM RED Yasopp
- Raid on Onigashima Roronoa Zoro
- Raid on Onigashima Franky
- Ex-Roger Pirates / First Mate Silvers Rayleigh
Adjusted the behaviors when being attacked by certain characters. Due to the adjustments, Traits and Status Effects that unintentionally activated in response to being attacked will no longer activate.
Made changes to the Stage gimmick ""Jump Cannon"" so that the cannons will no longer block attacks.
Adjusted Battle Replays to make it easier to see the displayed Additional Damage.

[h3]■ 6th Anniversary Thank You Campaign Coming Soon![/h3]
New Character ""4★ Blackbeard Pirates Kuzan"" arrives!

[h3]■ Correction Details[/h3]
Fixed an issue on the ""Impel Down Level 6 Stage"" where the following characters were able to traverse to unintended locations.
- Dorry The Blue
- Broggy The Red
*The affected stage can now be chosen for the following modes.
- League Battle
- Casual Match
- Room Match
Fixed an issue with Raid on Onigashima Tony Tony Chopper's Skill ""Chopperphage Nebulizer"" where moving into the Skill's area of effect could cause Status Effect Nullification to not activate.
Fixed an issue with characters capable of changing Class where the following Skill Effect could not be activated after Class Change.
- Deals increased damage to a certain Class.
Fixed an issue where under certain conditions, attacks would be aimed at distant characters.
Fixed an issue with the ""Thriller Bark Stage"" where certain skills could not set or create shields in specific areas.
Fixed a problem where ""Setting complete"" appeared on the Profile customization screen when an expired background or frame was set.
(Steam® Version)
Fixed an issue where stamps could not be used during battle in Thriller Bark Rush Battle.
(Steam® Version)
Fixed an issue where ""Select"" and ""Cancel/Return"" could become unbound in Settings > Control Settings
Adjusted some UI and text.
Fixed some display and effect-related issues.
Fixed some minor issues.

[h3]■ Saving Game Data Is Advised[/h3]
Deleting the application without completing the Transfer process will result in permanent loss of all save data.
It is advised to back up your game data to prevent loss of said data if you lose your device or accidentally delete the app.
Transfer settings can be made by going to Menu > Link Data from the top-right of the Home Screen and completing the process.

[h3]■ Precautions ■[/h3]

If the update is not visible in your app store, try rebooting your device or wait a while before trying again.
If issues occur after updating the app, such as being unable to progress, they may be resolved by updating the device's OS.
Please update the OS at your own discretion.
